example_sentences_in_bangla: বাচ্চাটা খুব রেগে কড়মড় শব্দ করছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is grinding his teeth in anger.
The child is making a gnashing sound out of frustration.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of teeth grinding, commonly used to depict intense anger in Bengali speech.
